item.title: Washing cars leaving spillages/mess, 13th November
item.description:
Guy washes cars outside his house at number 53 collwell avenue. Not just his own. Getting cold now so water is getting/turning slippery/icey. Children/people/elderly walk along this pavement so I feel this is dangerous as someone may slip & hurt themselves. He does it all year round, (been going in a few years at least) sometimes at school finishing time. Doesn’t salt the pavement or road once he’s finished nor does he wash the mess down the drain. Cars even had to slow down to go around him as he doesn’t tend to move out the way. I’m only reporting it due to safety reasons for children/eldery/people. Can anything be done about this at all? I’d also like to remain anonymous please. Not that they know me but I live further down the road
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Chosen Way, Hucclecote, Gloucester
Report on FixMyStreet
